title.narrative: Strengthening the response to measles outbreaks to reduce under-five mortality in four governorates in Yemen

description.narrative: - Reducing deaths among children and pregnant women 2- Reducing fetal malformations among pregnant women 3- Reducing deaths among Yemeni citizens 4- Reducing the spread of the epidemic to non-epidemic governorates 5- Supporting the steadfastness of the Ministry of Health and the Yemeni population in confronting epidemics and community diseases

The project aims to reduce the spread of measles through vaccination campaigns in four main governorates where the epidemic has spread. The project aims to vaccinate 1,205,336 children through 1,125 health centers where vaccination campaigns will be launched for the targeted children. The project also includes the purchase of equipment to support the cold chain to ensure sustainable routine immunization services in the selected areas. The project also includes support for essential activities in the water and environmental sanitation sectors, as these activities play a crucial role in reducing the spread of the epidemic. The project will provide medicines, intravenous solutions and consumables necessary to treat confirmed cases in all Yemeni governorates. Epidemiological investigation is one of the most important basic activities included in the project to ensure verification and rapid intervention in a timely manner when measles cases are detected, in addition to transporting samples and supporting laboratory tests.
